title: Supplied Example 3 — sales meeting memo
reference: Keep qualification, optional specialist analysis, offers/approvals, follow-up and contract/service handover.
Customer postponement is distinct from a lost opportunity.
A scope change returns to work estimation; a larger discount requires an unspecified approver/limit.
Sales work remains sales even when a consultant contributes; do not infer finance work or a CFO merely from price.
Preserve CRM/system evidence; never add Business Central, invoicing or service execution from the reference template.
